title: Wall Mount Double Glass Shelf 22-Inch Solid Brass Gallery Rail | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that adds two levels of organized space while keeping essentials close at hand.

  • Two-tier design: Double shelf layout is an ideal use of space.
  • Tempered glass: Made with 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for safety and strength.
  • Gallery rail: Designed to help keep items in place.
  • Solid brass hardware: Built with solid brass components.
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware.

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 22 x 5 Inches
  • Overall size: 22-Inch length x 5-Inch projection x 8-Inch height
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4)
  • Collection: Waverly Place collection
  • Designer finishes: Multiple finish options available to coordinate with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories

_previous.title: Waverly Place 22 Inch Double Glass Shelf with Gallery Rail
_previous.description: Add a flare of style to your décor with this decorative glass shelf. Shelf can be used anywhere in the home for a great space to store your products. Gallery rail will keep your items secure. Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
